new_venues.editorial_summary: Small semi-rural farm venue with an outdoor garden, a purpose-built chapel and a fire pit for the evening, framed by mountain views. Rustic and relaxed in feel, with a local bakery as the on-site catering partner.

new_venues.address: Art Gallery Road, The Domain, Sydney NSW 2000
new_venues.editorial_summary: Wedding receptions among the artworks beside the Botanic Gardens, with rare outlooks over Woolloomooloo and the harbour. Two reception areas suit up to about 250 guests, with seasonal menus from the gallery's caterer. Hire fees help fund the gallery's community programs.

Candlelit French dining room below street level with a vintage speakeasy mood, live jazz and classic cocktails. Four exclusive-hire spaces, and the whole restaurant can take up to about 200 guests. Suits couples after a moody, glamorous city celebration.

new_venues.address: Bay 3, 2 Locomotive Street, South Eveleigh NSW 2015
new_venues.editorial_summary: Grand function space inside restored locomotive workshops, mixing steam-age glamour with sleek modern lines. A sweeping staircase and balcony give a dramatic entrance, with vintage chandeliers, marble and brass details and very high ceilings. Takes roughly 200 to 600 guests, with a bridal suite and in-house sound.

Two-level rooftop-style lounge on top of Hotel Palisade with some of the best Harbour Bridge views in the city. Very intimate, with the largest room holding about 50 guests, and the hotel's eight rooms make a small wedding weekend easy.

new_venues.address: 21 Little Albion Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010
new_venues.editorial_summary: Boutique 35-room hotel in Surry Hills that can be hired exclusively, with a rooftop terrace and round-the-clock service. Guests sleep under the same roof, and pets are welcome. Good for a small, laid-back city wedding weekend.
Bright, quirky warehouse-style space in Marrickville, hired out on Sundays or by arrangement. Suits relaxed, creative receptions of 50 to 70 guests with a catered lunch or dinner.

Glamorous old-world bar and restaurant with private and semi-private rooms. The private dining room seats up to 28, and the whole venue can be hired for around 40 to 100 guests. A good fit for cocktail-led evening celebrations.

Romantic garden restaurant in Woollahra with lawns and a kitchen garden. Drinks and canapes outdoors after the ceremony, then dinner indoors on a seasonal paddock-to-plate menu. Private dining takes about 40 and the main room around 70.

Moody, old-world cocktail bar and French restaurant themed around liberated Paris, with several private spaces. Reopened with a livelier music-and-tequila personality. Holds 25 to 175 guests with bar sections or dedicated table service.

new_venues.service_area: Darling Point, Eastern Suburbs Sydney NSW
new_venues.editorial_summary: Elegant 1830s Gothic Revival mansion above the harbour in leafy Darling Point, with manicured gardens, a sandstone courtyard and room for a marquee. Hired exclusively, with period interiors and a sweeping driveway for a grand arrival. About 10 to 100 guests.

Refined, sunlit private dining room on the upper floor of a Paddington terrace, seating up to 12. Made for tiny weddings and elopement dinners, with custom menus and wine advice from the restaurant team.
Historic rooms inside the Mitchell Building, available for ceremonies and receptions from about 8 up to 200 guests. A grand, bookish backdrop beside the Botanic Gardens, with in-house caterers.

new_venues.vendor_name: Royal Botanic Garden Sydney (Palm House and lawns)
new_venues.editorial_summary: Garden lawns, a retro Palm House and heritage lodges beside the harbour, with outlooks to the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. Keep it natural or add a marquee and furniture. Phone is the garden's general line, not a dedicated venue-hire line.

Restored two-storey Victorian terrace with a wine bar, courtyard and a grand salon, serving Mexican-inspired food. Works for small to medium weddings of around 20 to 60, with in-house floral packages and full setup.

Victorian country estate dating to 1875, approached by a tree-lined drive, with big grounds and a heritage Garden Room lit by chandeliers. Atmospheric and old-world, about an hour from Sydney in the Southern Highlands.

Secluded 25-acre wildflower farm near Bowral with an exclusive-use package: a garden ceremony site in a hidden valley, a small barn, a garden marquee with a festoon-lit courtyard and a bridal suite. A blank canvas for relaxed, personal weddings, from food trucks to cocktail styles.

Scenic 35-acre mountain retreat with six ceremony sites, including an open deck, a natural bush cathedral and a stained-glass chapel. The reception room has a fireplace, chandeliers and valley views, and cottages sleep 34. Affordable packages from elopements to 150 guests.

Riverside 75-acre property on the Hawkesbury with casuarinas and bush-covered hills, feeling far from the city yet within 90 minutes. A blank canvas where you bring your own suppliers, with an in-house event team to help as much as you like.

new_venues.address: 121-133 Prairie Vale Road, Bossley Park NSW 2176
new_venues.editorial_summary: Three designer function spaces, the largest with high ceilings and gold-textured walls, taking about 750 seated or 950 cocktail. Free on-site parking and a grand foyer suit very large celebrations in Sydney's west.

Waterside venue on Gwawley Bay with four reception rooms and two garden areas for 10 to 600 guests. One newly renovated room has white arches, polished concrete and floor-to-ceiling windows over leafy gardens.

new_venues.service_area: North St Marys, Western Sydney NSW
new_venues.address: Boronia Road, North St Marys NSW 2760
new_venues.editorial_summary: Big, budget-friendly club event centre in St Marys that handles everything from catering to decorations and favours. Tailored packages for traditional or modern weddings, 20 to 500 guests. Email was found on a third-party listing; phone is from the Wedlockers description.

Weddings in the landmark itself: flexible all-weather rooms with dramatic harbour outlooks, an intimate Utzon Room beside the tapestry, and larger foyers for big cocktail parties. About 50 to 1000 guests.

new_venues.service_area: King Street Wharf, Sydney Harbour NSW
new_venues.editorial_summary: Bright, full-of-character floating venue on the harbour with a stage, three bars, lounges and an all-weather awning. Day or evening receptions for roughly 100 to 400 guests with a Mediterranean holiday mood.
Exclusive-use mountain amphitheatre run by a local couple who offer all-inclusive packages from tiny elopements to 200-guest weddings. Warm, personal and fairytale in spirit.

new_venues.service_area: Bondi Beach, Eastern Suburbs Sydney NSW
new_venues.address: 4A Queen Elizabeth Drive, Bondi Beach NSW 2026
new_venues.editorial_summary: Casual-elegant restaurant by Bondi Pavilion with beach views, sustainable local produce and coastal textures. Dining room hire up to 60 guests, 80 with the full space, or a private room for 20.
Five-star hotel on the harbour edge in The Rocks, with in-house wedding specialists, customisable packages (including an intimate one with a menu tasting) and ballrooms for about 250 to 900 guests.

Playful heritage wharf over the harbour: a pink chapel-like room, a pastel-mural Burbs Room with copper pillars, and an industrial Piper Room with old timber beams. Ceremonies happen on the 100-year-old wharf itself. 30 to 300 guests.
Charming garden estate on five landscaped acres in the Hills district, known for countryside-style garden ceremonies. Peaceful and storybook, with space for around 150 to 450 guests.
Heritage sandstone spaces across the University grounds, with gardens and plenty of character. The Refectory takes about 220 seated or 500 cocktail; smaller rooms from 18 guests.

Private first-floor restaurant in historic Hinchcliff House at Circular Quay. Needs little styling, with a DJ deck and AV built in, a seasonal Italian-with-a-twist menu and a lively mood. 75 seated or 100 cocktail.

new_venues.address: Top floor, 5-7 Young Street, Sydney NSW 2000
new_venues.editorial_summary: Top-floor event space in Hinchcliff House with exposed brick, timber beams and original windows letting in lots of light. Good for cocktail receptions and shared-table dinners for about 140 to 200 guests. Contact is the Hinchcliff House email shared with Lana.
Large-scale ballroom venue with glamorous rooms and underground parking for 350-plus cars, suited to very big multicultural weddings of up to about 1,340 guests.

new_venues.address: Hazelhurst Arts Centre, 782 Kingsway, Gymea NSW 2227
new_venues.editorial_summary: Elegant restaurant in the Art Deco Hazelhurst Arts Centre, with lawns and garden ceremony spaces and a European-influenced feel. About 120 seated or 180 cocktail.

new_venues.service_area: Milsons Point, Lower North Shore NSW
new_venues.address: Corner Northcliff and Paul Streets, Milsons Point NSW 2061
new_venues.editorial_summary: Italian dining room above the North Sydney pool with unobstructed harbour views, for 10 to 120 guests in a private room or whole venue. Flag: the operator page says it is closed for renovation and due to reopen in 2026, so confirm it is trading.
Heritage house with verandas and shady old trees on the North Shore, offering indoor receptions or a flat lawn, with several ceremony spots in the garden. About 130 to 150 guests.
Surf club perched above Clovelly Beach with sweeping ocean views and a mix of indoor and outdoor space. About 90 seated or 200 cocktail. Contact is the club's general admin line.
Landmark five-star CBD hotel with French-inspired elegance that has hosted weddings since 1966. Three reception venues from intimate family dinners to a ballroom gala of about 450 guests.
Heritage-listed 1836 building with high ceilings, skylights and glass floors, known for art and music. A distinctive city venue for roughly 40 to 300 guests.
Waterfront venue on Chowder Bay blending classic charm and modern polish, with a dedicated wedding team. Romantic harbour setting for up to about 200 guests.
Classically styled CBD venue with a light-filled bar, open-air courtyard and a formal dining room. Couples can marry in the nearby Botanic Gardens or on site. Anything from 10 to roughly 150 guests.

style_tags: ceremony to wedding night in one place
new_venues.editorial_summary: Art-inspired, industrial-style hotel among gum trees where ceremony, photos, reception and the wedding night happen in one place. Ballroom takes about 150 seated or 200 cocktail, plus an outdoor pool deck.

new_venues.service_area: Rouse Hill, North West Sydney NSW
new_venues.editorial_summary: Roomy pub-and-brewery function spaces for casual receptions and engagement parties for 40 to 300 guests, or the whole hotel for up to 1,400. Relaxed rather than formal.

Open-plan glasshouse-style dining room in the Botanic Garden, with tall windows opening to greenery, big overhanging trees and glimpses of the harbour. All-inclusive packages with grazing stations. About 150 seated or 250 cocktail.
Beachfront surf club function room with a full-length balcony over Killcare Beach toward Bouddi National Park. A rare DIY-friendly venue where you bring your caterer and style it yourself.

Italian restaurant on Brays Bay Reserve with glass doors opening to parkland and water views. Works for chic evening weddings or casual lunches, with a team that manages the day end to end. About 24 to 250 guests.

Heritage Hamptons-style beach house above Freshwater with ocean views and a private garden that feels like Italy's Amalfi coast. Award-winning Sardinian cooking and tailored packages for small weddings.
Urban-farm event space in the heart of the inner west with indoor and outdoor areas, for roughly 60 to 300 guests, a leafy oasis in the city.

new_venues.address: Shop 15, 5 Macquarie Street (Opera Quays), Sydney NSW 2000
new_venues.editorial_summary: Steak-and-seafood restaurant at Circular Quay with a hidden private dining room (about 45) and a harbour-view terrace. Good for small, bespoke weddings with the Harbour Bridge on the horizon.
Elegant high-level restaurant with 360-degree skyline and harbour views, with a private dining room for intimate weddings. About 28 to 120 guests, with bespoke menus.

Mediterranean-style villa among tall gums in a quiet valley, with private gardens, a terrace bar and a candlelit dining room with an open fireplace and grand piano. Family-run with a complete wedding service for 200 to 300 guests.

Harbourside theatre precinct with a ground-floor studio of exposed brick, ironbark beams and high ceilings, giving an arty warehouse feel. About 110 seated or 200 standing. Phone is the venue-hire team's line.
Large urban warehouse space whose event profits support survivors of modern slavery and trafficking, an ethical-wedding choice. About 100 seated or 150 cocktail.
Fine-dining restaurant beside the Opera House with floor-to-ceiling glass facing Circular Quay and the Harbour Bridge. Dedicated event spaces for roughly 30 to 100 guests.

new_venues.service_area: Royal National Park, Sydney South NSW
new_venues.address: 2 Lady Carrington Drive, Royal National Park NSW 2233
new_venues.editorial_summary: Heritage-listed dance hall in Royal National Park with a long verandah over the grounds and Hacking River and a full timber dance floor. A blank canvas that can go rustic, elegant or clean and modern, seating up to about 200.

Modern glass pavilion in the Botanic Garden with the largest vertical plant wall in the Southern Hemisphere and a terrace. Flexible from intimate to about 400 guests. Phone is the gardens' general line.

new_venues.address: D'Albora Marina, Spit Road, Mosman NSW 2088
new_venues.editorial_summary: Relaxed, private boutique waterfront venue on Middle Harbour with views over Pearl Bay and award-winning Italian food. Best for intimate receptions around 90 to 100 guests.
Hotel with a 25th-floor reception room framed by harbour, Opera House and Botanic Garden views (about 200 guests), plus a pillarless ballroom for up to 350 seated.
Waterside venue tucked under a huge Moreton Bay fig in Clontarf Reserve, with luxe coastal interiors, seasonal menus and bespoke packages. About 70 seated indoors, 100 cocktail.

existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Venue for non-traditional weddings with a rooftop bar under a glass canopy beside a pool; the boutique hotel lets guests stay over.
Historic Victorian CBD building with brick walls and tall ceilings, hosts 5 to 700 guests with a wedding coordinator. Same venue as Urban List's Alpha Events.
Includes Olio on Kensington Street: a bright contemporary dining room with arched windows and brick, Italian menu, around 75-85 seated or 120 standing.
Manor on 10 hectares of gardens at the harbour's edge, with sandstone architecture, ponds and alfresco ceremonies; menus can use produce from its own market garden.
Privately owned 11-acre estate in Bowral with lawns, gardens, a hedge maze and aviary, plus an on-site wedding planning service, about 90 minutes from Sydney.
Private 100-acre estate with an Italian-style villa, gardens and pool, available for exclusive use with marquees up to 200 guests.
Event spaces with sunset views of the bridge, Opera House and skyline, exclusive photo spots and the odd wild onlooker. Gili Rooftop: 60 seated/80 standing; N'Galawa Terrace: 150 seated/250 cocktail.
Cliff-top garden above Whale Beach for ceremonies and canapes, then dinner in the awarded restaurant, with an indoor wet-weather ceremony space.
Restored 140-year-old private chapel in wild-style gardens with an urban meadow for photos; receptions up to about 50 inside or a marquee on the lawn for more.
Waterfront venue in an award-winning green building with a glass facade onto a promenade and skyline views, seating up to 750.
Restored heritage finger wharf with a full-length private deck and bridge views; the main hall seats up to 680 or splits into two.

existing_venue_additions.db_vendor_name: The Australian Botanic Garden Mount Annan
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Huge native botanic garden 45 minutes from the CBD offering ceremony spots among Australian flora; hire fees reportedly $865-1,250.
Waterside wedding venues under fairy lights with Harbour Bridge sunsets and flexible planning packages.
Northern Beaches venue for sit-down or canape receptions.
Harbour National Park site with 33 hectares of ceremony and reception spots, from a cocktail-style Glasshouse to a formal ballroom.
Heart-of-Sydney waterfront venue facing the bridge and Opera House, with a team that guides styling and menus.
Harbourfront wedding spaces with 32 boutique suites for guests, led by an experienced events team.
Middle Harbour waterfront with its own beach, wharf, jetty and deck beside the Spit Bridge, plus a resident family of pelicans; 50-250 guests. Wedlockers calls it Orso Weddings Mosman.

extra_style_tags: views to Central Coast and Manly
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Secluded cove beach setting by Long Reef headland with views from the Central Coast to Manly.
Sunset-lit harbour water views with packages from cocktail style to traditional set menu, including canapes and live music.

extra_style_tags: ceremony photos reception in one place
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Refurbished heritage hall in Ashton Park with skyline, Opera House and bridge views; ceremony, photos and reception all on site.
Garden-led venue with indoor and outdoor spaces from elopements of 12 to big banquets.
Minimal, warehouse-style room just below street level with raw timber, original brick and leather seating.
Riverfront working farm on the Hawkesbury with paddocks, orchards, kitchen garden and native bush, relaxed yet refined.
Restored two-storey mansion on five acres with a wisteria-lined balcony and garden.
Well-loved reception venue on the shores of Balmoral Beach.

extra_style_tags: views to Camp Cove and Watsons Bay
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Bushland-surrounded venue on Chowder Bay with a big harbour deck and glamorous interior.
Luxurious waterfront venue with three exclusive outdoor ceremony spots and harbour views.
Opulent heritage tea room with palatial ceilings and crystal chandeliers, with in-house stylists.
Garden-led restaurant growing some of the ingredients it serves, with a seasonal menu.
Romantic 1810 homestead and winery in the Macarthur area, informal to elegant, up to 450 guests.
Private setting on Shelly Beach with water views.
Overwater event pavilion on the Georges River with ceremonies on the pavilion or sandy shore, modern-coastal feel.
Three waterfront spaces on Darling Harbour backed by nearly 40 years of wedding experience.
Modern-luxury Pearl Ballroom with metallic chandeliers and pre-function views, up to 320 seated.
Harbourside Kirribilli venue run by the Bird and Bear Group.

existing_venue_additions.db_vendor_name: Esplanade Events (Cronulla RSL & Cronulla Surf Life Saving Club)
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Works with every budget; wedding specialist on hand across Cronulla RSL and the surf club.
Enclosed rooftop with two terraces, private bar and onsite accommodation.
Nostalgic French-leaning cottage on Blackwattle Bay with a sunny terrace, ideal for food lovers.
Exclusive upper-level space for canape or sit-down weddings at Rose Bay House.
Four custom-designed event spaces in Dural, from intimate to extravagant.

existing_venue_additions.db_vendor_name: The William Inglis Hotel at Riverside Stables
existing_venue_additions.extra_description: Rural-soul hotel with over 23 event spaces and 144 rooms, bespoke full-service planning.
Bayside-village luxury hotel with spacious event spaces and tailored events, up to 495 guests.
Show-stopping ballroom with a grand staircase entrance, garden terrace and candlelit bridal table backdrop.
1920s former golf clubhouse with wrap-around balcony, harbour views and secluded Middle Head bush; two event spaces.
Waterfront destination venue inside the national park.
Iconic oceanside chapel with geometric architecture, stained glass and 360-degree Pacific views, seating 80 inside.
